anchor.semantic_hook: A subject is narrowed to a specific case by being physically enclosed inside one case while all other subjects remain outside.
anchor.setting: A quiet selection chamber contains a central inspection table, shelves of ordinary objects, and a plain equipment cabinet. Its single impossible feature is a room-sized transparent carrying case that closes around exactly one chosen object without moving it, leaving every neighboring object outside. All surfaces and props are unmarked.
anchor.absurd_element: one room-sized transparent case that encloses only the selected subject

inserts.action: sits inside the transparent case, concentrates on the counting frame, and works through the equation pieces with a pencil
leans beside her as the private tutor, guides one calculation with a pointing hand, and gives an encouraging nod

variations.scene_adjust: a counting frame, geometric solids, loose equation pieces without marks, and two study chairs occupy the inspection table

inserts.action: stands inside the case with travel bag ready, presents her closed passport booklet, and waits attentively
examines the passport under the inspection lamp, compares it with the Brazil-shaped map piece, and gestures permission to proceed

variations.scene_adjust: a Brazil-shaped map piece, a closed passport booklet, a travel bag, and an inspection lamp rest on the table

inserts.action: reclines inside the case with one hand pressed to her chest, reaches toward the emergency kit, and looks urgently at the clinician
kneels beside her, checks her pulse, and raises a reassuring hand toward the untouched work clock and coin purse

variations.scene_adjust: an open medical kit without markings, a folded work coat, a clock without digits, and a closed coin purse surround the table

inserts.action: holds a dripping smartphone inside the case, points to water beneath it, and looks disappointed

variations.scene_adjust: a plain smartphone with a dark screen, a shallow puddle, repair tools, and a closed warranty folder occupy the table

inserts.action: sits inside the case, carefully compares the ingredient dishes, and points to her irritated skin before choosing the safe meal

variations.scene_adjust: a dining setting, a separately covered meal, a nut bowl, an ingredient tray, and a clean napkin rest on the table

variations.scene_adjust: an apartment model, a house key, one combined pile of coins, and a maintenance tool token occupy the inspection table

Its single impossible feature is that the tree bears completed outcomes in place of ordinary fruit, each outcome attached directly to a branch above its contributing objects. Everything else in the workshop is ordinary and unmarked.
anchor.absurd_element: one tree that grows finished outcomes as fruit

inserts.action: harvests the completed project model from its branch, balances it proudly above the gathered work tools, and acknowledges the combined effort with open arms

variations.scene_adjust: a completed project model hangs over a basket filled with many different work tools and joined construction pieces

inserts.action: cradles the smooth ripe fruit calmly, studies the widening growth rings on its branch, and settles into a relaxed seated pose

variations.scene_adjust: a smooth ripe fruit, a branch with many visible growth rings, and a row of emptied hourglasses occupy the tree bed

inserts.action: lifts a bound volume from the branch, compares it with the magnified historical objects below, and smiles at the completed investigation

variations.scene_adjust: a closed bound volume hangs above a magnifying lens, archival photographs of old objects, gloves, and carefully sorted artifacts
